title: eucalyptus cephalocarpa
intro: Eucalyptus cephalocarpa, commonly known as the forest red gum, is a species of eucalyptus native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include relieving respiratory issues, such as congestion and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of E. cephalocarpa include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an analgesic, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
